title: When is Hotelling's $T^2$ asymptotically $F$-distributed?
summary: For Gaussian observations, a deterministic multiple of Hotelling's $T^2$ statistic has an exact $F$ distribution. This paper investigates when this approximation remains valid for an independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) data matrix $\mathbf{X}\in \mathbb{R}^{p\times n}$ with a fixed, possibly heavy-tailed entry law $ξ$. Under symmetry and $\limsup_{n\rightarrow \infty} p/n x)=0$ when $p/n\rightarrow γ\in (0,1)$, and obtain the $F$ approximation as a consequence.
